name: Medcomms + KOL Event Series Owners

fit_logic.proceed: They have KOL + audience + sponsor model already. This is one of the cleanest ICP fits if execution owner exists.
fit_logic.stop: Expect Yoke to generate the audience without the KOL engine

what_they_sell: Sponsor packages tied to KOL authority + audience engagement
what_proof_means: Trendlines, confidence shift, decisions, gaps across the series. Evidence to increase sponsor price and renew annual packages.
yoke_strengths: Proof + longitudinal insight as the sponsor product
Editorial guidance: what to do more/less of, based on evidence
yoke_weaknesses: If they expect Yoke to generate the audience without the KOL engine

messaging.value_proposition: Yoke helps KOL series owners turn events into a longitudinal product—with trendlines and always-on engagement that justify higher sponsor packages.
key_benefits: Maintain engagement between events with always-on modules
Generate trendlines across series for sponsor proof
Prove confidence shifts and decision impacts
Get editorial guidance on what topics/formats work
messaging.elevator_pitch: KOL event series need to prove impact beyond attendance. Yoke keeps engagement alive between events and generates trendlines—turning your series into a product that commands higher sponsor prices.

two_lever_framing.lever_a: Increase sponsor packages with longitudinal proof
two_lever_framing.lever_b: Reduce between-event drop-off and content production burden

competitor_gap.failure_moment: Sponsor renewal meeting: we show attendance numbers and satisfaction scores, sponsor asks 'But did behavior change? What did they actually learn?'
competitor_gap.consequence: Lost sponsor renewal ($50k-100k) or forced price reduction

deadline_triggers.signal: Planning next event, need proof from previous
Sponsor deciding budget allocation for next year

standard_rollout.description: White-label iCases setup, upload existing content, run in-room on iPads/laptops, instant analytics dashboard

icp_score.rationale: Highest scoring ICP. Clear failure moment (sponsor renewal pressure), hard deadline triggers (quarterly reviews), proven standard rollout (Medscape iCases), buyers easily reachable (MD/Commercial Director level), evidence can be validated quickly with discovery calls.
